% Tier 1+2 verification samples — visually inspect each in 한글.

Frac: $\frac{a}{b}$
Sqrt: $\sqrt{x+1}$
Root: $\sqrt[3]{x}$
Sup/sub: $a_i^n$
Sum: $\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_i$
Int: $\int_a^b f(x) dx$
Lim: $\lim_{x \to 0} f(x)$
Greek: $\alpha + \beta = \Gamma$
Fn: $\sin x + \cos y$
Op: $a \le b \ne c$
Delim: $\left( a + b \right)$
Hat: $\hat{A} + \bar{x} + \vec{v}$
Combined: $\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_i}{\sqrt{n}}$
Math fonts: $\mathcal{D} \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, $\mathfrak{g}$, $\mathbf{v}$
